sentences.en: This special episode of Office Ladies is brought to you by Hershey's Kisses.
sentences.zh: 本期《办公室女士》特别节目由好时之吻巧克力为您呈现。

sentences.en: So earlier this year, we recorded our first ever live Office Ladies episode.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，我们录制了《办公室女士》有史以来的第一场现场节目。

sentences.en: People flew in from all over.
This is some of our, like, OG Office Ladies fans that have been with us from the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 这里面有一些从一开始就陪伴我们的《办公室女士》元老级粉丝。

sentences.en: We got to meet so many of you.
sentences.zh: 我们见到了你们当中的许多人。
那绝对是一段非常愉快的时光。

sentences.en: And we couldn't be happier to partner with Hershey's to now bring it to you all to listen.
sentences.zh: 我们非常高兴能与好时合作，现在将这段录音呈现给大家收听。

sentences.en: This collaboration is kind of perfect because later on in the episode, we are going to talk about kisses.
sentences.zh: 这次合作堪称完美，因为在节目稍后的部分，我们要聊聊“吻”这个话题。

sentences.en: We dive back into the debate about a certain first kiss on the office.
sentences.zh: 我们将重新探讨《办公室》中关于某个初吻的争论。

sentences.en: But first, let's talk about a different kind of kiss.
sentences.zh: 但首先，让我们聊聊另一种“吻”。

sentences.en: Well, you know, the holidays are a time to break out your best outfits.
sentences.zh: 你知道，节日是穿上你最漂亮衣服的时候。

sentences.en: And when it comes to candy, I'm sorry, but is there a better dress treat than a Hershey's Kiss with its sparkling festive foils?
sentences.zh: 说到糖果，抱歉，还有什么比穿着闪亮节日包装纸的好时之吻更精致的甜点吗？

sentences.en: This holiday season, you and your family will delight in decorating the house with Kisses chocolates dressed in shining red, green, silver foils.
sentences.zh: 这个节日季，你和家人可以用包装着红、绿、银色闪亮锡纸的好时巧克力来装饰屋子，一定会让你们感到欣喜。

sentences.en: Their snowman foils are even Santa hats.
sentences.zh: 它们的雪人包装纸甚至还戴着圣诞帽。

sentences.en: The Santa hats are so cute.
sentences.zh: 那些圣诞帽真是太可爱了。

sentences.en: My mom stole my bag of Santa hats.
sentences.zh: 我妈偷走了我那袋戴圣诞帽的巧克力。
了解更多信息请访问 www.hersheyland.com。

sentences.en: Sam, can we get a theme song?
We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为你制作了这档终极《办公室》重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会剖析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们两人才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: We know a lot of you traveled to be here.
sentences.zh: 我们知道你们很多人是特地赶来的。

sentences.en: We cannot tell you how much we appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们无法用言语表达我们的感激之情。

sentences.en: This is tears here in the first row.
sentences.zh: 第一排这里有人流泪了。

sentences.en: It's going to make us cry.
That's the one thing we didn't think of, Ange.
sentences.zh: 安吉，这是我们唯一没想到的事。

sentences.en: So this is our very first time recording a podcast in front of a live audience.
sentences.zh: 这是我们第一次在现场观众面前录制播客。

sentences.en: It might be flunky, but we'll get through it.
sentences.zh: 可能会有点手忙脚乱，但我们会搞定的。

sentences.en: But just seeing your faces here is just making my heart beat so faSt.
sentences.zh: 看到你们在场，我的心跳得好快。

sentences.en: You know I have to document it for office ladies.
sentences.zh: 你们知道我得为《办公室女士》记录下这一刻。

sentences.en: So today, we are going to do our mailbag fan appreciation episode.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要录制一期粉丝回馈的信箱问答节目。
这就是你们今天到场的原因。

sentences.en: You know, so many of you have written in over the years and have just shared your stories with us.
sentences.zh: 多年来，你们中有许多人写信给我们，分享你们的故事。

sentences.en: So, and we just thought it would be really fun to open up our office ladies mailbag with you all.
sentences.zh: 所以我们觉得，和大家一起打开《办公室女士》的信箱会很有趣。

sentences.en: And we're just so happy you're here.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很高兴你们能来。

sentences.en: But first, we want to introduce you to our team.
sentences.zh: 但首先，我们要向大家介绍我们的团队。
没错，我们的《办公室女士》团队。

sentences.en: So, first of all, our senior producer, Cassie Jerkins.
sentences.zh: 首先是我们的高级制作人，凯西·杰金斯。

sentences.en: And we also have our editing and mixing engineer, Jordan Duffy.
sentences.zh: 还有我们的剪辑和混音工程师，乔丹·达菲。
以及录音室工程师，萨姆·基弗。

sentences.en: And our associate producer, Ainsley Babaco.
sentences.zh: 还有我们的助理制作人，安斯利·巴巴科。

sentences.en: We also have Colin and Cody there around the corner somewhere.
sentences.zh: 科林和科迪也在角落那边。

sentences.en: We have a reception little party planned for after, so you'll get to meet everyone.
sentences.zh: 我们之后安排了一个小型招待会，你们可以去见见大家。

sentences.en: Everyone that helps us make the show mean so much to us.
sentences.zh: 每一位帮助我们制作节目的人对我们来说都意义非凡。

sentences.en: Our merchandise team, Ileana, who does our website, everyone here at SiriusXM that helped make this happen today.
sentences.zh: 还有我们的周边团队、负责网站的伊莱亚娜，以及今天在SiriusXM帮助我们实现这一切的每一个人。

sentences.en: So, we thought we would kick things off with a piece of mail about our team, a particular team member.
sentences.zh: 我们想先从一封关于我们团队成员的信开始。

sentences.en: I've gotten a lot of these letters.
sentences.zh: 我收到了很多这样的信。

sentences.en: You got a fan mail flurry about it.
sentences.zh: 你收到了一大堆关于这个的粉丝来信。

sentences.en: I got a fan mail flurry about it.
sentences.zh: 我确实收到了一大堆粉丝来信。

sentences.en: This one is from Marnie W.
Marnie said, hi, in the last episode I listened to, you said our associate producer is Ainsley Bubaco,
sentences.zh: 玛妮说，嗨，在上一期节目里，你们说助理制作人是安斯利·巴巴科，

sentences.en: rather than Ainsley Bubaco, as you have been pronouncing it in all of the previous episodes.
sentences.zh: 而不是你们之前所有节目里一直念的那个发音。

sentences.en: Did Ainsley let you know you've been saying her name?
sentences.zh: 安斯利有告诉你，你一直把她的名字念错了吗？

sentences.en: I've been intrigued by her name ever since I first heard it on your show, and I want to know all about this, please.
sentences.zh: 自从在你们节目里听到她的名字，我就一直很好奇，我想了解关于这名字的一切，拜托了。

sentences.en: Marnie, I'm going to tell you.
I have known Ainsley for going on 10 years.
sentences.zh: 我和安斯利认识快10年了。

sentences.en: We had the same acting coach when I was working on my book, The Actor's Life.
sentences.zh: 我在写《演员的生活》那本书时，我们用的是同一个表演教练。

sentences.en: She was one of my readers.
She did the transcriptions for me.
We've been friends a long time.
sentences.zh: 我们认识很久了，是老朋友。

sentences.en: She joined the office ladies team and is still doing our transcriptions.
sentences.zh: 她加入了《办公室女士》团队，至今仍在负责我们的转录工作。

sentences.en: She helps us with our outlines.
In all of these years of knowing her, I never had a reason to say her last name to her face.
sentences.zh: 认识她这么多年，我从来没理由当面叫出她的姓氏。

sentences.en: Because, listen, this is a Southern thing.
sentences.zh: 因为，听着，这是南方人的习惯。

sentences.en: Like, my mom's friend is Sue Dean.
sentences.zh: 比如，我妈妈的朋友叫苏·迪恩（Sue Dean）。
那就是她的名字，苏·迪恩。

sentences.en: But you don't go around saying, hi, Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 但你不会到处去说，嗨，安吉拉·金赛（Angela Kinsey）。

sentences.en: I never had occasion to do this until we are at a party celebrating our 100th episode of Office Ladies.
sentences.zh: 直到我们在庆祝《办公室女士》第一百集的派对上，我才有了机会这样做。

sentences.en: We threw a fun dinner party because we love a party.
sentences.zh: 我们举办了一场有趣的晚宴，因为我们热爱派对。

sentences.en: And Jenna and I thought we would get up and thank our team.
sentences.zh: 珍娜和我想着要站起来感谢我们的团队。

sentences.en: And that's when Ainsley was like, by the way, you've been saying my last name wrong for a lot of episodes.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，安斯利（Ainsley）说，顺便提一下，你们在很多集里都把我的姓读错了。

sentences.en: I was like, Ainsley, you've been listening to them.
sentences.zh: 我说，安斯利，你一直在听这些节目啊。

sentences.en: Why did you wait so long to tell us?
sentences.zh: 你为什么等了这么久才告诉我们？

sentences.en: Two, I knew that I had never said my last name to you, so you didn't know any better.
sentences.zh: 第二，我知道我从未当面告诉你我的姓氏，所以你并不知道正确的读法。

sentences.en: And three, the show is, you know, a train that has left this station.
sentences.zh: 第三，节目就像一列已经发车的火车，停不下来了。

sentences.en: So I just thought, why mess up a good thing?
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，为什么要破坏一件好事呢？

sentences.en: Well, I'm very happy we are now pronouncing your last name correctly.
sentences.zh: 好吧，很高兴我们现在能正确读出你的姓氏了。

sentences.en: We're going to open up a lot of mail with you guys.
sentences.zh: 我们要和大家一起拆开很多邮件。

sentences.en: I want to start off with something that I know you're going to love, Angela.
sentences.zh: 我想先从一件我知道你会喜欢的事情开始，安吉拉。

sentences.en: This is a letter from Joe V in Oregon, who did an in-depth breakdown of what it costs Jim to prank Dwight.
sentences.zh: 这是一封来自俄勒冈州乔·V（Joe V）的信，他深入分析了吉姆（Jim）捉弄德怀特（Dwight）所花费的成本。
没错，我一直都在说这个。

sentences.en: Like, how does he have the time?
How does he have the money?
Okay, he does not break down the time.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他没有分析时间成本。

sentences.en: But he does break down the actual coSt.
sentences.zh: 但他确实细分了实际成本。

sentences.en: But he made a few caveats.
sentences.zh: 但他提了几点注意事项。

sentences.en: So I'm going to tell you.
First, he only tallied the cost of Jim's pranks played on Dwight.
sentences.zh: 首先，他只统计了吉姆捉弄德怀特的成本。

sentences.en: He does not include any pranks on Michael, Andy, Pam, Karen, Todd Packer, Gabe, anybody.
sentences.zh: 他没有包括捉弄迈克尔、安迪、帕姆、凯伦、托德·帕克、盖博或其他任何人的成本。

sentences.en: He also did not factor in any loss of sales commissions.
sentences.zh: 他也没有把销售佣金的损失计算在内。

sentences.en: Due to the time spent on pranking.
sentences.zh: 因为花在恶作剧上的时间。

sentences.en: And he did not consider any costs that would be part of, like, office supplies or office expenses.
sentences.zh: 而且他没有考虑任何属于办公用品或办公开支的成本。

sentences.en: So, like, for example, in season one, when he sets up all the pencils.
sentences.zh: 比如，第一季里他把铅笔摆成那样的时候。

sentences.en: He just raided the supply cabinet.
sentences.zh: 他只是洗劫了办公用品柜。

sentences.en: He also did not include Jim's gutenpranks during Dwight's Bestest Munch Festival.
sentences.zh: 他也没有算上吉姆在德怀特的“最佳零食节”期间搞的恶作剧。

sentences.en: Finally, his prices are based on 2023 dollar value.
sentences.zh: 最后，他的价格是基于2023年的美元价值计算的。

sentences.en: He did not go through and, like, figure out the dollar value in 2005, 2006.
sentences.zh: 他没有去逐一核算2005年、2006年的美元价值。

sentences.en: So then what he did was he broke it down season by season.
sentences.zh: 所以他做的是按季度进行了细分。

sentences.en: He listed every single prank, its approximate cost, and then a total for that season.
sentences.zh: 他列出了每一个恶作剧、其大致成本，以及该季度的总计金额。

sentences.en: I want to say I was shocked at the number of pranks that cost zero dollars.
sentences.zh: 我想说，零成本的恶作剧数量之多让我感到震惊。

sentences.en: Like the pencil one I told you about.
sentences.zh: 比如我刚才跟你说的那个铅笔恶作剧。

sentences.en: Oh, because of the supply cabinet.
sentences.zh: 哦，因为用了办公用品柜里的东西。

sentences.en: For example, in all of season one, the total amount of money spent was only $1.39.
sentences.zh: 例如，整个第一季，花费的总金额只有1.39美元。

sentences.en: And that was for the box of Jell-O that he put his stapler in.
sentences.zh: 那还是因为他把订书机放进的那盒果冻的钱。

sentences.en: Every other prank from season one was using found objects and office supplies.
sentences.zh: 第一季里其他所有的恶作剧都是利用现成物品和办公用品完成的。

sentences.en: So maybe I didn't have to be so grumpy at Jim.
sentences.zh: 也许我不该对吉姆那么暴躁。

sentences.en: Maybe he's not blowing his salary on pranks.
sentences.zh: 也许他并没有把工资都花在恶作剧上。

sentences.en: You tell me, in the end, over all nine seasons, he spent $1,889.11 on pranks.
sentences.zh: 你来告诉我，总的来说，在九季的时间里，他一共花了1889.11美元在恶作剧上。

sentences.en: What happened to like, like just like silly string?
sentences.zh: 那像喷彩带之类的恶作剧呢？

sentences.en: Well, that would have cost probably what?

sentences.zh: 恶作剧也是积少成多的。

sentences.en: Is the moral to this story.
sentences.zh: 这就是这个故事的寓意。

sentences.en: The most expensive pranking season is season eight.
sentences.zh: 最烧钱的恶作剧季度是第八季。
那一季里，吉姆花了634.25美元。

sentences.en: Do you want to know what the single most expensive prank was?
sentences.zh: 你想知道单次最昂贵的恶作剧是什么吗？

sentences.en: Is it all the gift wrapping when he gift wrapped the whole, when he made the fakie desk?
sentences.zh: 是那个包装礼物的恶作剧吗？就是他把整个办公桌都包起来，做了一个假桌子的时候？

sentences.en: The single most expensive prank was in season three.
sentences.zh: 单次最昂贵的恶作剧发生在第三季。

sentences.en: Anybody out here have a guess?
It was not the power line.
It was when he shipped Dwight's desk to Roswell, New Mexico.
sentences.zh: 是他把德怀特的办公桌寄到新墨西哥州罗斯威尔的时候。

sentences.en: He says this was a deleted scene, but the cost of that prank would have been $500.
sentences.zh: 他说这是一个删减片段，但那个恶作剧的成本要500美元。

sentences.en: And the second most expensive was in season eight in Free Family Portrait Studio.
sentences.zh: 第二昂贵的恶作剧是在第八季的“免费全家福摄影棚”那一集。

sentences.en: He estimates that, you know, when he switched Dwight's suit with a tearaway Velcro suit.
sentences.zh: 他估计，你知道，就是他把德怀特的西装换成那种一撕就开的魔术贴西装的时候。

sentences.en: He thinks that cost about $310 because he had to buy a suit, he had to have a tailor sew Velcro into it, and he had to tip the dry cleaner.
sentences.zh: 他认为那大概花了310美元，因为他得买一套西装，还得找裁缝缝上魔术贴，还得给干洗店小费。

sentences.en: Now, if anyone would like to do a breakdown of the amount of time Jim has spent on a prank, I would love to read it.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果有人愿意统计一下吉姆在恶作剧上花的时间，我很乐意拜读。

sentences.en: Joe, are you up for it?
Yes, Joe, give us all the data.
sentences.zh: 没错，乔，把所有数据都交出来。

sentences.en: I am going to title my section, Y'all Are So Crafty.
sentences.zh: 我要把我这一节的标题定为：你们真是太狡猾了。

sentences.en: Because over the years, you have sent us so many things, from scrunchies for our pets to cross-stitched items, drawings, personalized drinkware, jewelry, homemade stationery.
sentences.zh: 因为多年来，你们送了我们太多东西，从宠物的发圈到十字绣、画作、定制水杯、首饰，还有自制文具。

sentences.en: That's just to name a few.
sentences.zh: 这还只是其中一小部分。

sentences.en: I'm going to put a bunch of stuff in stories.
sentences.zh: 我打算在快拍里展示一大堆东西。

sentences.en: We love to see what you guys make.
sentences.zh: 我们很喜欢看你们制作的作品。

sentences.en: Not as well as these crafts.
But I wanted to highlight Linda C.
sentences.zh: 但我特别想提一下琳达·C。

sentences.en: because she got super crafty over the holidays, and she made us each these little ugly Christmas sweater ornaments.
sentences.zh: 因为她在假期里大显身手，给我们每人都做了这些丑丑的圣诞毛衣挂饰。

sentences.en: And Sam and Cassie, she made you one, too.
sentences.zh: 还有萨姆和卡西，她也给你们俩各做了一个。
我简直无法用言语形容这些东西。

sentences.en: Look at Phyllis' Santa, and then little sweater, and then wait, hold, look, look, it's a cat, it's a cat.
sentences.zh: 看看菲利斯的圣诞老人，还有那件小毛衣，等等，别动，看，看，是只猫，是只猫。

sentences.en: That segues me very well into something that I received for us, Angela.
sentences.zh: 这正好引出了我为我们收到的东西，安吉拉。
我很兴奋能分享给大家。

sentences.en: We each got beautiful, handmade cardigan sweaters.
sentences.zh: 我们每人都收到了一件漂亮的纯手工针织开衫。

sentences.en: Michelle said, I am a huge fan, and I love the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔说，我是你们的超级粉丝，我超爱这个播客。

sentences.en: I listened at home while working on my latest clothing collection.
sentences.zh: 我在家一边听播客一边制作我最新的服装系列。

sentences.en: I cut and sew everything by hand with a little help from my mom.
sentences.zh: 在妈妈的一点帮助下，我所有的衣服都是手工裁剪和缝制的。

sentences.en: I designed my clothing to be comfortable.
sentences.zh: 我设计服装的初衷就是为了舒适。
这其实是我唯一的标准。

sentences.en: Michelle, who are you talking to?
sentences.zh: 米歇尔，你在跟谁说话呢？

sentences.en: Michelle goes on to say, I know you gals are always cold, so hopefully this will keep you warm.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔接着说，我知道你们几个总是觉得冷，所以希望这件衣服能让你们暖和起来。

sentences.en: Plus, they have pockets, and they are made in Winnipeg, and I hope you like them more than a bag of ketchup chips.
sentences.zh: 而且，它们有口袋，产自温尼伯，希望你们会比喜欢一袋番茄酱薯片更喜欢它们。

sentences.en: Michelle, I love mine so much, I'm wearing it.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔，我太喜欢我的这件了，我现在就穿着呢。

sentences.en: That looks like not something that a person could make.
sentences.zh: 这看起来根本不像是人能做出来的。

sentences.en: You can find Michelle on Instagram at slyscarves.
sentences.zh: 你们可以在Instagram上通过slyscarves找到米歇尔。

sentences.en: Well, I want to share about Rowan.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想分享一下关于Rowan的事。

sentences.en: Rowan is 16 years old and wanted to share with us that in high school, she had really bad anxiety,
sentences.zh: Rowan今年16岁，她想告诉我们，她在高中时有非常严重的焦虑症，

sentences.en: and she would turn to the office on rough days, in particular season four, episodes seven through ten.
sentences.zh: 每当日子难熬时，她就会转向我们的节目，特别是第四季的第七到第十集。

sentences.en: And Rowan went on to say that the show feels so calming and familiar, and that because she knows the show so well, it feels like revisiting a childhood memory.
